title: Drunk Man Gets Arrested After Obnoxious Behavior on Flight
description:
A day in the life of a police officer...

On September 6, 2021, Salt Lake City Police Department received information about an intoxicated passenger onboard an American Airline flight. The man reportedly was growling and yelling racist, sexist, and belligerent comments at other passengers. He even demanded to get off the flight although it was still 30,000+ feet in the air. After the flight landed safely, police officers boarded the plane.
